newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms AA long-term on Spain's DFA.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms AA long-term on Spain's DFA.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Tuesday it affirmed the long-term AA and short-term A1 plus foreign currency ratings on Spain's Diputacion Foral de Alava.
"The ratings reflect the DFA's sound fiscal management and low level of indebtedness, and apply to its senior unsecured and short-term issues," IBCA said in a statement.

The DFA levies and collects directly over 90 percent of all taxes in the Basque province of Alava, of which approximately 15 percent is retained by the DFA to cover its own operating costs and to fund investment projects, IBCA said.
It said the province had a higher GDP (gross domestic product) growth rate and higher GDP per capita than the national average in Spain.
"It also enjoys a more diversified economy," it added.

"Unemployment levels, although high, are still below the national and regional average, and the moderate but evident improvement in the economic situation in the region should translate into reduced unemployment and increased taxation revenues in the future."
IBCA said the province also benefits from a positive balance of payment.
"The provincial government continues to exercise sound financial management and the present and projected ratio of debt to gdp and taxation revenues are within comfortable limits."
